title: Strain-induced modification of spin-optical dynamics in silicon vacancy centers for integrated quantum technologies
summary: Silicon vacancy (VSi) centers in 4H silicon carbide have emerged as a highly promising platform for semiconductor-based quantum technologies, combining excellent spin and optical properties with an industrial-grade, CMOS-compatible material. As these defects are increasingly integrated into practical quantum devices, they inevitably encounter lattice strain. However, while the impact of strain is well documented for other solid-state defects like NV centers in diamond, its specific influence on key VSi spin dynamics such as initialization fidelity and state lifetimes remain largely…
